conventions.convention: Dimensions n,d,v and block size b are positive integers; each fixed allowed-key set is nonempty. Empty intermediate blocks are skipped, but all-masked rows are outside the domain.
An empty summary is the separate state ⊥, with no numeric maximum or normalizer; the merge formula applies to disjoint nonempty sets.
Arithmetic is exact over the reals. Reverse differentiation holds c, the allowed-key sets, and G fixed, and uses retained normalization statistics without differentiating maximum operations.
Scalar arithmetic, exponentials, comparisons, and mask membership queries have unit cost. Caller-owned mask storage is counted separately from additional workspace.
The base algorithm has no dropout; a dropout extension must replay the same realized mask during reverse recomputation.

load_bearing.statement: For positive n,d,v,b, finite real Q,K,V, real c, fixed nonempty allowed-key sets and fixed upstream G, the forward output equals the dense masked exponential weighted average, and the reverse procedure returns the Euclidean gradients of Φ(Q,K,V)=ΣᵢΣₐGᵢₐYᵢₐ with c, the allowed sets and G held fixed, including ties at row maxima.

For exact-real inputs with fixed nonempty allowed-key sets, process each query's key blocks using empty-state handling and summary merges, return Y and final row maxima and normalizers, and recompute probabilities blockwise to accumulate dQ,dK,dV for a supplied upstream G.

A nonempty allowed-key subset has summary (m,ℓ,z), consisting of its maximum score, shifted exponential normalizer and shifted weighted-value sum. Disjoint nonempty summaries merge by rescaling both to their common maximum; the empty set has the separate state ⊥.

In the stated unit-cost real-arithmetic model, each procedure uses O(n²(d+v)) operations, O(n(d+v)) stored input and output scalars and at most O(b+v) additional live scalars, without materializing an n×n score or probability array; caller-owned mask storage is counted separately.
